name: Camp David Accords
kicker: 1978 Egypt–Israel peace framework · Brokered by Jimmy Carter in Maryland
briefing: For 13 days in September 1978, President Jimmy Carter hosted Egypt’s Anwar Sadat and Israel’s Menachem Begin at Camp David, the presidential retreat in Maryland’s mountains, and pushed them toward peace. The Camp David Accords led to a 1979 treaty in which Israel agreed to return the Sinai Peninsula and Egypt became the first Arab country to recognize Israel. Sadat and Begin shared the 1978 Nobel Peace Prize.
answerHtml: Camp David Accords (accept Framework for Peace in the Middle East; prompt on Egypt–Israel Peace Treaty; do not accept “Oslo Accords”)
accept: framework for peace in the middle east

tossups.p: During the talks that produced these agreements, the host took the other two leaders to tour the Gettysburg battlefield. Those talks lasted thirteen days in September 1978, at a presidential retreat in Maryland’s mountains.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these 1978 agreements between Anwar Sadat of Egypt and Menachem Begin of Israel, brokered by Jimmy Carter.

tossups.p: On the last day of the talks that produced these agreements, the American president gave one leader signed photographs, each addressed by name to one of that leader’s grandchildren. The gift moved the leader at a moment when the talks seemed close to collapse.
tossups.r: That leader was Menachem Begin of Israel. For 10 points, name these 1978 agreements that Begin made with Anwar Sadat of Egypt.

tossups.p: Secretary of State Cyrus Vance and National Security Adviser Zbigniew Brzezinski [“ZBIG-nyev breh-ZIN-skee”] were on the American team that negotiated these agreements. American officials kept rewriting a single draft text and carrying it between the two other delegations.
tossups.r: These agreements are named for the Maryland retreat where the talks took place. For 10 points, name these 1978 accords negotiated by Jimmy Carter, Anwar Sadat, and Menachem Begin.

tossups.p: Israel’s Foreign Minister Moshe Dayan and Defense Minister Ezer Weizman took part in the talks that led to these agreements. One of these agreements set out a plan for a peace treaty in which Israel would give back land it had taken in 1967.
tossups.r: That land was the Sinai Peninsula. For 10 points, name these 1978 agreements between Egypt and Israel.

tossups.p: Lawrence Wright’s 2014 book _Thirteen Days in September_ tells the story of the talks that produced these agreements. During those talks, the host kept the leaders and their teams together, away from reporters, at a guarded retreat in the Catoctin Mountains.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these 1978 Middle East peace agreements, named for a presidential retreat in Maryland.

tossups.p: The site of the talks that produced these agreements was called “Shangri-La” by Franklin Roosevelt, after a hidden paradise in James Hilton’s novel _Lost Horizon_. In 1953, Dwight Eisenhower renamed that presidential retreat in honor of his father and his grandson.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these 1978 agreements between Egypt and Israel, named for that Maryland retreat.

tossups.p: The talks that produced these agreements took place at a presidential retreat run by the U.S. Navy, which is officially named Naval Support Facility Thurmont, inside Maryland’s Catoctin Mountain Park. The leaders and their teams stayed in cabins there for thirteen days in September 1978.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these 1978 agreements reached by Jimmy Carter, Anwar Sadat of Egypt, and Menachem Begin of Israel.

tossups.p: In November 1977, one leader who later signed these agreements flew to Jerusalem and spoke to the Knesset [“kuh-NESS-it”], becoming the first Arab head of state to visit Israel. Less than a year later, he met the Israeli prime minister in Maryland.
tossups.r: That leader was Anwar Sadat of Egypt. For 10 points, name these 1978 agreements brokered by Jimmy Carter.

tossups.p: One of these agreements called for Palestinian self-government in the West Bank and Gaza during a five-year transition period, but that plan was never carried out. The other set the terms for a peace treaty between two neighboring countries.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these 1978 accords between Egypt and Israel, signed after talks at a Maryland retreat.

tossups.p: After one country signed a treaty based on these agreements, the Arab League suspended it and moved the league’s headquarters out of that country’s capital to Tunis. That country was not readmitted until 1989.
tossups.r: That country was Egypt. For 10 points, name these 1978 accords brokered by Jimmy Carter between Egypt and Israel.

tossups.p: On October 6, 1981, one leader who signed these agreements was assassinated by extremists while watching a military parade in Cairo. His vice president, Hosni Mubarak, took over and kept the peace that these agreements had begun.
tossups.r: That leader was Anwar Sadat. For 10 points, name these 1978 accords that Sadat reached with Menachem Begin.

tossups.p: In 1982, an international force called the Multinational Force and Observers began patrolling a desert peninsula to support a treaty that grew out of these agreements. That year, Israel finished handing the peninsula back to Egypt.
tossups.r: That peninsula was the Sinai. For 10 points, name these 1978 accords brokered by Jimmy Carter.

tossups.p: Israel had captured a large desert peninsula from Egypt in the Six-Day War of 1967, and Egypt tried to win it back in the 1973 Yom Kippur War. These agreements led Israel to promise to return that land in exchange for peace and recognition.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these 1978 accords, signed after Jimmy Carter hosted Anwar Sadat and Menachem Begin in Maryland.

tossups.p: On March 26, 1979, leaders shook hands on the White House lawn after signing a peace treaty that grew out of these agreements. With that treaty, Egypt became the first Arab country to officially recognize Israel.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these 1978 accords negotiated at a Maryland retreat by Jimmy Carter, Anwar Sadat, and Menachem Begin.

tossups.p: Nikita Khrushchev [“KROOSH-chef”] met Dwight Eisenhower in 1959 at the retreat that names these agreements, and in 2000, Bill Clinton hosted talks there with Ehud Barak and Yasser Arafat that ended without a deal. These agreements came out of an earlier summit there, in September 1978.
tossups.r: For 10 points, name these accords between Egypt and Israel, brokered by Jimmy Carter for Anwar Sadat and Menachem Begin.

trap.title: Accords, retreat, or treaty?
trap.body: This answer line has close neighbors. Camp David is the presidential retreat in Maryland, which also hosted Eisenhower and Khrushchev (1959) and a failed 2000 summit with Bill Clinton, Ehud Barak, and Yasser Arafat. The accords (1978) were frameworks for peace, and the actual Egypt–Israel Peace Treaty was signed in 1979. The Oslo Accords (1993) were a different agreement, between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization.
trap.fix: For “these agreements” or “these accords,” say “Camp David Accords” in full, since some answer lines only prompt on “Camp David.” If the question asks for “this treaty,” it may want the 1979 Egypt–Israel Peace Treaty; if it asks for “this retreat,” say Camp David.
